statement: Perfect completeness for 2-to-1 games. Proves Khot's 2-to-1 Games Conjecture with perfect completeness: for every fixed rational $`\delta\in(0,1)`$, it is NP-hard to distinguish satisfiable games from games whose optimum is at most δ, on explicit unweighted instances. The alphabet depends only on δ, and every right-hand label has exactly two preimages under each constraint map.
